registry_binding.qualification: Selects source records with an explicitly identified impurity phase, balanced target reaction, concrete precursor and target compositions and original DOI. Native unknown/variable identities are excluded; partial known subsets are flagged. The61937 no-impurity-report cohort is never used as negative evidence. Source labels are extracted literature observations, not computationally generated candidate phases. Materials Project most-stable-entry assignments/energies are omitted from all features and references. Native synthesis operations are DOI-level context and may not map uniquely to a particular recipe, so exact condition-specific causal claims are unsupported. Original publication and reaction identity must be grouped in eventual benchmark splits.
registry_binding.reference_evidence: Source Data Records explicitly distinguish intended target from impurity_phase entities and retain original publication DOI. Primary Technical Validation describes source extraction, balancing and thermodynamic validation. Figsharev1 grantsCC-BY4.0 for the native80806-record structured data file.
